description: A PostHog logs alert: counts log entries matching a filter over a time window and fires when the count crosses a threshold. Notification destinations are managed separately.

FilterGroup.description: JSON (use Fn::ToJsonString). Property filter group, e.g. {"type": "AND", "values": [{"type": "AND", "values": [{"key": "message", "type": "log", "operator": "icontains", "value": "timeout"}]}]}.

BlockedWindows.description: Blocked local time windows (project timezone) when the alert must not run. Overlapping windows are merged by PostHog. At most five.

Start.description: Start time HH:MM (24-hour, project timezone), inclusive.

End.description: End time HH:MM (24-hour, project timezone), exclusive. Each window must span at least 30 minutes.

Mode.description: `single` keeps one instance for the whole alert. `by_result_labels` keeps one instance per distinct value of the labels in Keys, each firing and resolving on its own (needs ThresholdOperator `above`).

Keys.description: Result labels whose values make a group, such as service_name or severity_text. Empty for `single`, required for `by_result_labels`. Changing them deletes existing instances.

MaxInstances.description: Most instances the alert keeps at once (1-100, default 100).

OnOverflow.description: What happens to groups past MaxInstances. `degrade_visible` (default) names how many were left out.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the alert belongs to.

Enabled.description: Whether the alert is evaluated. Defaults to true. Disabling resets its state to not_firing.

Filters.description: Which log entries are counted. An enabled alert needs at least one of SeverityLevels, ServiceNames or FilterGroup.

ThresholdCount.description: Number of matching log entries in the window that breaches the threshold. Defaults to 100. Use 0 with `above` to fire on any matching log.

ThresholdOperator.description: Whether the alert fires when the count is `above` (default) or `below` the threshold.

WindowMinutes.description: Time window in minutes over which log entries are counted. Defaults to 5.

EvaluationPeriods.description: Total number of check periods in the sliding evaluation window (M in N-of-M). Defaults to 1.

DatapointsToAlarm.description: How many periods within the evaluation window must breach the threshold to fire (N in N-of-M). Defaults to 1.

CooldownMinutes.description: Minimum minutes between notifications. 0 (default) means no minimum. Does not apply to PagerDuty incidents.

ScheduleRestriction.description: Quiet hours: local time windows when the alert must not run. Omit to disable quiet hours.

Grouping.description: How the alert splits its results into instances. Only alerts evaluated by the PostHog alerts platform (PlatformOwned) can use a mode other than `single`.

Labels.description: Labels that say who owns the alert and how urgent it is, e.g. {"team": "checkout", "severity": "critical"}. `alertname` and names starting with `posthog_` are reserved. Only PlatformOwned alerts can have labels.

Annotations.description: Context for responders, e.g. {"runbook_url": "https://..."}. Values can use {{ $labels.<name> }} and {{ $value }}; names ending in _url must start with https://. Only PlatformOwned alerts can have annotations.

CheckIntervalMinutes.description: How often PostHog evaluates the alert, in minutes. Server-managed.

PlatformOwned.description: Whether the PostHog alerts platform evaluates this alert and sends its notifications. Server-managed.
